_doc: Chain-stage catalog for SEQUENTIAL robot-diversity composition (#29). Each entry is a VERIFIED chain-ready block with a source/receiver role + handoff geometry. A chain stage_k delivers its object to a HANDOFF (height handoff_z, on a surface vs into a container), and the next stage picks FROM that handoff. The handoff-compatibility rule (chain_compat in compose_handoff.py) predicts whether (src,recv) chain, grounded in the proven pairs — it would have pre-filtered the cont.262 CP-73->CP-13 failure (CP-73 delivers into a deep Bin; a Franka receiver needs a pickable flat surface).
handoff_rule: A source delivers onto a SURFACE at handoff_z; a receiver picks at pick_height. They chain iff (a) the source delivers onto a FLAT/RAISED surface (NOT into a deep bin/container — a receiver arm cannot pick from inside a deep bin), AND (b) source.handoff_z matches receiver pick envelope: UR10 picks RAISED (~0.975 pedestal), Franka picks FLAT (~0.775). UR10 delivers flat; Franka delivers flat or raised.
